envelope.description: The queue file at schema version 2, with markWaiting and resendFrom

body.title: The queue file at schema version 2, with markWaiting and resendFrom
body.summary: In chat-queue-store.ts: the CREATE TABLE messages gains the nullable waiting_on column and SCHEMA_VERSION becomes 2; on open a version-1 file gets the column by ALTER TABLE in the open transaction and records version 2, keeping its rows; rowToMessage maps waiting_on to QueuedMessage.waitingOn. Add markWaiting(seq, on), which sets or clears waiting_on only on a processing row, and resendFrom(seq, newTurnId, windowKey), resend's single transaction with the given window key (AMD-7, AMD-4).
acceptanceChecks: A fresh file is created at version 2 with waiting_on; a version-1 file opens as version 2 with its rows kept and waitingOn empty
markWaiting sets and clears waitingOn on a processing row and returns false on any other state
resendFrom re-queues a failed or not-delivered message at the back with its text and attachments under the given window key, and refuses any other state
A file newer than version 2 is still refused with the newer-plugin message

tests.name: schema 2: a fresh queue file is created with the waiting_on column at version 2, and a processing row can be marked waiting
schema upgrade: a version-1 queue file opens as version 2 with its rows kept and waitingOn empty, and a newer file is still refused
markWaiting sets and clears waitingOn on a processing row only
resendFrom: a failed or not-delivered message joins the back with its text and attachments under the given window key; any other state is refused
